name: Putri Kelas Atas
overview: Hidden from the public, Princess Tunku Fatima Amelia is thrust into the real world when her father sends her to a boarding school after she rebels against palace life. There, Amelia navigates teenagehood and the attention of three boys - Zaid, the bad boy with a heart of gold; Iqbal, the strict prefect; and Akid, the star athlete - all vying for her heart. Their rivalry intensifies with the arrival of Rafeeq, a charming newcomer who quickly becomes the school's most popular student. But when the boys uncover Amelia's royal identity and her secret engagement to Rafeeq, her princely cousin, love and loyalty are put to the ultimate test.
